question: Add a limits[].kind term for a time-boxed trial that stops sending or serving at its end (time-boxed)?
why: email/sendgrid stops sending over the web API and SMTP when its 60-day trial ends, and names request-rate with the time box in binding_note; email/fastmail (a trial of up to 30 days that loses sending and receiving when unpaid), email/migadu (a time-limited trial of unverified length), email/mailersend (a 14-day Professional trial that ends on the Free plan) and email/mailo (the 4-month Discovery offer) have the same shape.
